ja279:1.1: Yathā māṇavako panthe sigāliṃ vanagocariṃ atthakāmaṃ pavadantiṃ anatthakāmā ti maññati anatthakāmaṃ satapattam atthakāmo ti maññati
ja279:2.1: Evam evam idh' ekacco puggalo hoti tādiso, hitehi vacanaṃ vutto patigaṇhāti vāmato.
ja279:3.1: Ye ca kho naṃ pasaṃsanti bhayā ukkaṃsayanti ca taṃ hi so maññate mittaṃ satapattaṃ va māṇavo ti.
